items.title: Michael Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 22, 2021
items.q: Well I only had one personal experience with her and that was being on her show.

ctx.x: I don’t do it that much. Actually I don’t have a whole lot of experience like some pianists, working with vocalists. But I’d like to think the same criteria are in play you know, with a vocalist singing a ballad or a tenor saxophonist singing a ballad through their horn.
Well I only had one personal experience with her and that was being on her show.
